_comment: Per-language baselines for bench/scope-capture/measure.mjs --check. fingerprint = order-independent sha256 over the lang-resolution/<lang>-* fixture corpus + a 20-entity synthetic source (correctness gate; re-baseline intentionally on a legitimate capture change). scaling_budget = max allowed (t800/t250)/(800/250); ~1.0 is linear, ~3.2 is quadratic. The synthetic source is now HERITAGE-BEARING for every language (each Entity extends/implements/embeds/uses-trait/conforms-to a shared base) so the #1951 @reference.inherits synth is gated at scale, not just the base capture loop. All languages thread the tree-sitter captured node instead of re-deriving it with findNodeAtRange(tree.rootNode,...) per match, so all are linear (go #1915, python #1918, ruby/php/rust/csharp #1951, java #1956).

go._rebaselined: #1956: heritage-bearing scale source (struct embedding of Base) so the inheritance synth is gated at scale; linear (~1.05).

cobol._note: COBOL has no inheritance construct, so its scale source stays flat; unchanged.

c._added: #1956: c added to the scope-capture bench (was UNBENCHED). C has no inheritance — flat scale source. Adding it exposed + fixed a pre-existing O(n^2) findNodeAtRange root-walk in c/captures.ts (threaded c.node, byte-identical over c-* fixtures); scaling 3.475 -> 0.96.

cpp._added: #1956: cpp added to the scope-capture bench (was UNBENCHED). Heritage-bearing scale source (: public Base, public Mixin) drives emitCppInheritanceCaptures at scale. Adding it exposed + fixed a pre-existing O(n^2) findNodeAtRange root-walk in cpp/captures.ts (~12 sites, threaded c.node, byte-identical over 263 cpp-* fixtures); scaling 2.30 -> 1.12.

csharp._rebaselined: #1956: heritage-bearing scale source (class extends Base + implements IEntity); both edge forms gated at scale; linear (~1.04).

rust._rebaselined: #1956: rust-cross-module-collision fixture + heritage-bearing scale source (impl Shape for Entity_n trait-impl) so the trait-impl synth is gated at scale; linear (~1.01).

php._rebaselined: #1956: heritage-bearing scale source (class extends Base + use trait); both forms gated at scale; linear (~1.04).

ruby._rebaselined: #1956: heritage-bearing scale source (class < Base + include mixin); both forms gated at scale; linear (~0.97).

swift._rebaselined: #1956: swift-qualified-base fixture + heritage-bearing scale source (class: Base, Serviceable — extends + protocol conformance); linear (~1.03).

java._added: #1956: java added to the scope-capture bench (was UNBENCHED). Heritage-bearing scale source (class extends Base implements Marker). Adding it exposed a pre-existing O(n^2) findNodeAtRange(tree.rootNode,...) root-walk in java/captures.ts — the #1848/#1915/#1918 family bug, never fixed for java because java had no bench. Fixed by threading the query's captured c.node (byte-identical capture output, verified by a before/after digest over all java-* fixtures); scaling now linear (~0.99, was 3.09).

typescript._rebaselined: #1962: F44 (class scope@), F85 (enum member declarations), F87 (optional_parameter type annotations) add new captures — fingerprint drift expected.

javascript._added: #1951: bench coverage added (was ungated); scale source heritage-bearing (extends Base); js/kotlin O(n^2) findNodeAtRange-per-match fixed to threaded captured node, now linear.

kotlin._added: #1951: bench coverage added (was ungated); scale source heritage-bearing (: Base()); js/kotlin O(n^2) findNodeAtRange-per-match fixed to threaded captured node, now linear.
